# Run book: Hash, sign, compare and calculate

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/use-the-toolbox.md) | [Spec](../specs/use-the-toolbox.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Pick the algorithm by key from configuration instead of hard-coding it; the default hash is SHA-512, and signing and vector math are one call each.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Hash, sign, compare and calculate"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/utilities/toolbox`:

1. **Hash some text.** Choose an algorithm and press Hash. The same text always gives the same hash. Expect: A hash is shown.
2. **Sign a message.** Sign a message with a shared secret; the receiver recomputes the signature to prove the message is unchanged. Expect: A signature is shown.
3. **Compare two vectors.** Compare two number lists under cosine, Euclidean, dot product and Manhattan distance. Expect: All four distances are shown.
4. **Calculate an expression.** Type an expression with a variable, give the variable a value and calculate. The service also shows the optimized form. Expect: The result, optimized form and variable names are shown.
5. **Get a one-time code.** Leave the secret empty to generate one, then read the current code and the authenticator URI. Expect: A code and an otpauth URI are shown.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unknown algorithm error | The key is not one of the registered keys | Use the keys in the lists (sha512, hmac-256, ...) |
| Could not evaluate the expression | Variables must start with a capital letter and have a value | Use A or Rate2, and give each a value as name = value |
| Compare is disabled | The vectors are not numbers or differ in length | Enter the same count of numbers in both |

Related framework features: OoBDev.System (`IHash`, `IHMACCalculator`); OoBDev.System.Abstractions (`VectorMath`).
